name: Deepwell Memory Sharing Circles
description: Deepwell Memory Sharing Circles are intimate, trust-based gatherings of four to eight participants who exchange voluntarily selected memory fragments via BCI in a facilitated format derived from both therapeutic practice and older oral storytelling traditions. Unlike Hollowground's free-form dreamspace, Deepwell sessions are structured around a specific prompt — a first loss, a moment of unexpected beauty, a decision regretted — with each participant offering a curated memory clip that others experience in first-person for thirty to ninety seconds. The practice has spread rapidly through Tier 2-3 communities since 2218 as an antidote to the perceived shallowness of feed-based social connection.
story_hooks: A Deepwell circle facilitator receives a memory fragment from a new participant that contains — buried in the peripheral detail of an apparently mundane memory — clear evidence of a corponation black site operating in the outer stack

A participant in a the Gray Zone-based Deepwell circle realizes that one of the other members is sharing fabricated memories — perfectly constructed, emotionally resonant, and completely false — and needs to understand why
A Tier 5 intelligence operative has been attending Deepwell circles in disguise for six months; her cover is about to be blown by a participant who recognizes something in her shared memories
